skill_name: Create a story that's 100 words long beginning with the sentence "Once, there was a witch who had a spell book".
workflow: Once, there was a witch who had a spell book filled with the mysteries of the magical world. She kept it hidden away, away from the prying eyes of the villagers who feared and despised her. She had great power, so much so that she felt she could never be truly free or accepted. One day, she decided to take her spell book and run away from the village, away from the fear and judgement.
